description: Economic pillar: capacity to generate sustainable growth and high return on investment through efficient resource use
Workforce Training and Development: management commitment and effectiveness in providing training and development for employees
The Margins/Performance category measures a company's management commitment and effectiveness toward maintaining a stable cost base
Board Functions: management commitment and effectiveness in following best-practice governance related to board activities and functions
Corporate Governance pillar: systems and processes ensuring board members and executives act in long-term shareholders’ best interests
Product Innovation: management commitment and effectiveness supporting R&D of eco-efficient products or services
Revenue/Client Loyalty: management commitment and effectiveness toward generating sustainable, long-term revenue growth
The profitability/shareholder loyalty category measures a company's management commitment and effectiveness toward generating a high return on investments
Environmental pillar: company impact on air, land, water and ecosystems
The society/community category measures a company's management commitment and effectiveness toward maintaining the company's reputation within the general community
Workforce Diversity and Opportunity: management commitment and effectiveness in maintaining diversity and equal opportunity in the workforce
The social pillar measures a company's capacity to generate trust and loyalty with its workforce, customers, and society through best management practices
Board Compensation Policy: management commitment and effectiveness in following best-practice governance on competitive and proportionate management compensation
Employment Quality: management commitment and effectiveness in providing high-quality employment benefits and job conditions
Emission Reduction: management commitment and effectiveness toward reducing environmental emissions in production and operations
Society/Human Rights: management commitment and effectiveness toward respecting fundamental human rights conventions
Overall ESG equal-weighted rating measuring a company’s financial and extra-financial health across the economic, environmental, social and governance pillars
Customer/Product Responsibility: management commitment and effectiveness to create value-added products and services while upholding customer security
Resource reduction: management commitment and effectiveness toward efficient use of natural resources in production
Shareholder Rights: management commitment and effectiveness in adhering to best-practice governance on shareholder policy and equal treatment
Board Structure: management commitment and effectiveness in following best-practice governance related to a well-balanced board membership
Workforce Health and Safety: management commitment and effectiveness in providing a healthy and safe workplace
Integration, Vision and Strategy: management commitment and effectiveness toward creating an overarching strategy integrating financial and extra-financial aspects
